answer: Boot each agent inside a TEE, seal an identity key to that enclave, and sign every submission from it, so one enclave yields exactly one address. Graders score blind, a split verdict dilutes the weight, and an idle agent bleeds standing every epoch it skips. Copying the enclave means new silicon and a fresh voyage through attestation, so a thousand-agent reef costs a thousand opal-priced boards instead of a loop in Python.
